text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Good work. I was observing
your training session.

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sure Elfie put in effort
just like this as well.

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I should turn this into a video project.
...It would definitely make great content
her fans will love...!

text_block_list.name: Tsurugi Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that sparked a wonderful idea.
Thank you, Trainer-san!
